description: This file defines the 'DefinedTest' class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for checking if a variable or attribute is defined in the current context within Twig templates.

classes.name: DefinedTest
classes.description: A class extending TestExpression to implement the 'defined' test in Twig, which checks if a variable or attribute is defined within the current template context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DefinedTest object, setting appropriate attributes on the node based on its type, and handling deprecation warnings.

methods.name: changeIgnoreStrictCheck
methods.description: Recursively modifies GetAttrExpression nodes to disable strict checking and mark them as non-optimizable.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the test into PHP code using the provided Compiler object.
